lessons.name: AN OBSTRUCTION AT MODULUS 24, REDUCED EXPONENT 2. An unbounded conclusion from a finite table. It settles the coprime case only — classically Case I — and infinitely many triples sharing a factor with 24 pass through untouched, so the coprime half is what it decides and the other half is untouched.
